scope: Tradier stock exit and mandatory-reentry paths prioritized for profitable/top exits

rules.engine_truth: backtest_v8_engine.py plus the real Tradier call path
rules.side_convention: LONG adverse structure is LH+LL/downturn; SHORT is HH+HL/upturn

candidates.finding: The 2026-07-25 local patch now waits for a failed retest and preserves the arm across the structural veto. A confirmed signal still clears stored pending state before downstream zero-score, cooldown, NOLOSS and order-execution gates acknowledge a full close.
candidates.desired_semantics: Arm on adverse break, observe the favorable retest, execute only after that retest fails; preserve state across vetoes and blocked orders.

candidates.finding: The DeltaTracker two-phase path now treats LH+LL/HH+HL as failed-retest confirmation. The generic structural gate can still authorize other already-emitted exits immediately, and independent hybrid/scalper paths retain immediate structure exits.
candidates.desired_semantics: HTF LH+LL for LONG or HH+HL for SHORT arms the delayed-retest state; it should not itself claim the unconfirmed top.

candidates.finding: LONG/SHORT logic is mirrored and uses stocks 5m plus 15m/HTF confirmation. Both delta-gated and standalone live branches exist, while the engine also has inline copies. Confirm one close per bar and identical parabolic bypass.
Per-symbol TF list and minimum count are read in live. Engine contains alias injection for prefixed and non-prefixed sweep names.
Config defaults True, but both LONG and SHORT implementations are inside a dead commented-out function and the engine has no read.
Opposite-direction HTF scoring is present in both. Config default is 12, while fallback literals differ (live 18, engine 15.5); harmless only while the attribute is always present.
This is an early HOLD return, not just a filter on GR exits; when enabled it blocks every later profitable/top exit in evaluate_stop. Treat as a global exit-authority gate.

Live and engine are wired but global-only. The engine has multiple explicit SRS passes in addition to real exit evaluation; verify deduplication, identical indicator names and identical strict cascade.
String TF controls the path; None disables. LONG closes on lower high plus lower low, SHORT on higher high plus higher low. Engine contains more than one implementation.
Profit-only partial harvest and full slope-flip close are live-wired. All knobs use bare global config reads, so per-symbol matrix overrides are not reproducible live.

Enabled and TF are wired per symbol, but only inside MTF_EXIT_USE_COMPOUND. MTF_EXIT_MIN_OPEN_TS is an absolute 2026-05-20 cutoff, excluding most historical engine positions; a nonpositive value is replaced with real wall-clock startup time and is also unsuitable for simulation. MTF_DC_REJECT_EXIT_LOOKBACK is never read.

The absolute MTF_EXIT_MIN_OPEN_TS cutoff excludes most historical positions. Tag memory then uses wall-clock time.time() and a hard-coded 300 seconds per lookback bar. In fast simulation, timestamps do not advance with simulated bars, making the lookback effectively unbounded and wrong for non-5m bases.
Two-of-three 1h/4h/D divergence and WT z-score extremes correctly mirror LONG/SHORT and arm pending state, but the shared pending-veto collision can discard the intent.
Uses cycle_peak_gain and is side-neutral. It is deliberately capable of closing after profit erodes into the configured negative floor. Bare global reads prevent per-symbol tuning.
Live freezes the adverse DC level on first observation rather than guaranteed entry-bar capture. Default is OFF after near-breakeven commission churn.
Tradier configs exist and the engine implements them, but tradier_manage.py has no live reads. Results cannot be promoted until live parity is implemented.

MANDATORY_REENTRY is a reason tag, not an unconditional reopen. The monitor first requires the exit score to clear, applies SYMGATE, and for 30 minutes requires a dc_high4_5m break for LONG or dc_low4_5m break for SHORT. After the window it falls back to normal tiers.

The always-launched trc paper scalper closes LONG on one 5m lower high and SHORT on one higher low, with no delayed retest. It directly calls place_order and deletes its local position state even when the order raises. It is not represented in backtests or the switch matrix.
